opening.argument: The presentation links a 5,030-euro Tycoon Package to 60,000 tokens and presents an account value of 24,000 euros after the package’s splits, supporting its appeal through substantial token and account-value growth. It then makes recruitment central to earning: viewers are told they make money from direct sales, receive commissions as their team builds, and obtain matching bonuses. The network structure extends to people “a hundred levels down,” showing that income is tied to a multi-level downline rather than merely to discussion of cryptocurrency. Finally, the invitation that this is “the best time and the right time to get involved,” together with the closing call to partner with the team today, supplies an immediate path to participation.
